families.title: Revolved Profiles
families.description: Build pinched columns, flared profiles and open wire shells by editing the form's silhouette.

families.title: Cell Fields
families.description: Make a colored mosaic confined to an editable local patch, or strip it back to cell outlines, facets and site marks.

families.title: Path Materials
families.description: Path Materials draws marks along a local family of seeded, bending trajectories.

families.title: Orbital Brush
families.description: Shape a family of closed paths, then draw equal-distance samples as beads, connected ribbons or short perpendicular dashes.

families.title: Contour Fields
families.description: Draw flat contour patches from waves, noise, hills or your own height grid, without a filled background.

families.title: Spaced Marks
families.description: Spaced Marks is a Poisson-disc placement instrument for drawing at sites at least Minimum separation apart.

families.title: Packed Shapes
families.description: Packed Shapes generates a seeded population of rectangles, then gives that ordered population to skyline packing.

families.title: Flow Traces
families.description: Paint filled strips beside genuine RK4 trajectories through a sampled vector grid.

families.title: Rule Rows
families.description: Make angular row patterns, sparse triangular growth or irregular binary textures; choose the mark shape independently of the pattern.

families.title: Grammar Paths
families.description: Grammar Paths lets you write an axiom and parallel productions for F, G, X, Y.

families.title: Edge Tiles
families.description: A sparse, edge-matched mosaic made by adjacencyTileCollapse2D.

families.title: Lattice Forests
families.description: Lattice Forests builds a local four-neighbor lattice, removes seeded blocked sites, and runs seededDepthFirstSpanningTree separately on each connected island.

families.title: Dithered Marks
families.description: Dithered Marks composes an independently seeded set of compact features into a local scalar image.

families.title: Proximity Replay
families.description: Build current-neighbor webs or sparse chains from an editable moving population.

instruments.title: Motif Ecologies
instruments.description: Build an open population of dots, rings or rosettes; replace its marks without moving the underlying sites.

instruments.title: Contour Scores
instruments.description: Turn editable terrain into continuous ink, tangent stitches or interchangeable bead marks.

instruments.title: Region Quilts
instruments.description: Fill an editable rectangular partition with hatching, motif populations or contour scores, leaving chosen leaves open.

instruments.title: Wallpaper Motifs
instruments.description: Repeat one motif with any of the seventeen plane symmetry groups; marks are colored by operation so the symmetry is visible, with optional stable breaking.

instruments.title: Ordered Disorder
instruments.description: Push a regular lattice out of order with one correlated field of drift, turn, swell and omission, strongest around a chosen focus.

instruments.title: Recursive Cell Worlds
instruments.description: Grow compartments within compartments by recursive subdivision, then fill the leaves with hatching, motif populations or contour scores.

instruments.title: Fold Atlas
instruments.description: Push a grid through chained coordinate maps that fold, swirl, invert or unroll it; lines and nodes follow the same mapping.

instruments.title: Graph Roles
instruments.description: Read one network in separate roles: a thin supporting web, a bold focal route between two chosen places, node motifs sized by connectivity and fills only in genuine planar faces.

instruments.title: Optical Plates
instruments.description: Two editable pattern plates (lines, rings, dots, waves, spokes), linked or detached, alone or overlaid, with one following a type or region mask.

instruments.title: Branch Ornament
instruments.description: Grow a branching tree toward an editable attractor field, then attach blossoms, joints and pennants by branch role, with stitched or inked stems and a separate outline.

instruments.title: Substitution Tilings
instruments.description: Grow a Penrose rhombus or chair tiling by exact substitution, then edit the tile interiors, shared edges and vertex marks; color follows ancestry and any tile class can be omitted.

instruments.title: Gesture Scores
instruments.description: Replay a recorded hand movement with its timing and pressure as a broad bristle brush, a lagging fall of sand and glyphs along the path; one time window and smoothing reshape all three.

instruments.title: FM Engraving
instruments.description: Engrave a picture as wavy line bands: scan lines run across its tones, and where it is dark the waves grow taller and quicker while the lines crowd or thicken; light places stay open paper.

instruments.title: Image Directed Field
instruments.description: Lines and marks that follow or cross the structure of a picture: edges and contours become evenly spaced strokes of ink, stitches or beads that stop where the picture has no direction.

instruments.title: Sand Deposition
instruments.description: Sand falls from a moving spline: its control points travel through time, grains are released along the curve and land with a delay, and their accumulated density is drawn as exposed grains, isolines, or both; a protected region stays empty and a sparse crisp copy of the generating curve can lie on top.

instruments.title: Data Scores
instruments.description: Let recorded values decide structure: three bundled tables with missing values become a lattice that drifts, a treemap with exact areas or a timeline, with explicit mappings and a small generated key.

instruments.title: Pixel Sorting
instruments.description: Dissolve a bundled image into ordered streaks: pick the scan direction, the value interval that selects runs, the sort key and order, and a protected region that stays exact; drawn as merged vector bars or stitch-like streaks, with run outlines from a path material.

instruments.title: Stroke Relief
instruments.description: Deposit variable-width, pressure-loaded strokes into a height field with an explicit rule for crossings (add, maximum or displace), then light it: edge ridges and bristle furrows catch a movable light. The flat pigment layer and the transparent light-and-shadow patch are separate layers.

instruments.title: Quilled Paths
instruments.description: Paper strips stood on edge along contour lines, letter outlines, spirals or scattered scrolls, nested inside one another and rolled at the ends, drawn with thickness and occlusion from a tilted camera or as a flat plan.

instruments.title: Bundled Relations
instruments.description: Draw weighted relationships between grouped places as readable families of curves: edges share waypoints only when they join the same two groups, with bundle strength, hub depth, separation, a highlighted family and direction shown by color or arrows.

instruments.title: Typographic Rhythm
instruments.description: Repeat a phrase huge, then look at it through a grid or partition of modules whose windows slide, stretch and turn the type; other modules become line screens, flat colour or paper, and a small legible caption stays outside the fragments.

instruments.title: Slit Compositions
instruments.description: Recompose one image through parallel slices with editable ordering, offsets and scales, or slit-scan a short bundled frame sequence so that time is stretched into bands. Vector bands, a slice table from output band to source, and a few unsliced fragments for comparison.

instruments.title: Path Typography
instruments.description: Set a line of text along contours, a branch chain or a recorded hand stroke: letters keep their advance along the path and follow its direction, and are dropped, narrowed or turned where a tight bend would make them collide, or disrupted in correlated runs.

instruments.title: Crossing Lace
instruments.description: Weave paths wherever they really cross: every crossing is found exactly, given an over and under strand by an alternating, seeded or ranked rule with editable exceptions, and the under strand is cut open around it. A braid knot, a Celtic plait, two contour families or random loops.

instruments.title: Nodal Plates
instruments.description: Grains gather along the nodes of combined standing waves, the sand-on-a-plate figures: square, rectangle or disc, one edge condition, and up to four weighted modes. Nodal lines, node bands and grains all come from one analytic field, so material and grain edits never move them.

instruments.title: Dry Bristles
instruments.description: Carry a broad brush of separate hairs along any path (harmonic traces, a contour family or a hand scribble): hairs lift on light pressure and paper tooth, run dry, taper at the ends and gather into tufts, while the other paths stay fine stitched contours.

instruments.title: Painterly Source
instruments.description: Assemble a picture from marks in coarse-to-fine layers: broad strokes first, finer ones only where the paint still differs from the source, turned along its edges and colored from it; mark family, material and color are separate choices over one plan.

instruments.title: Adaptive Compartments
instruments.description: Divide a picture into a mosaic whose cell size follows its detail, big quiet cells where it is flat and small ones along its edges, then fill each cell with flat color, hatching along the local direction, halftone dots, a nested glyph or a stitched border, and leave a chosen share open.

instruments.title: Field Marks
instruments.description: The source is a set of sample positions, not an automatically full-canvas texture.

instruments.title: Path Marks
instruments.description: These trajectories follow the existing seeded gradient-path operation.

instruments.title: Placement Marks
instruments.description: The seeded source proposes circles within a movable rectangle: Source X and Y set its center, Source width and height its dimensions, and Proposals how many candidates the existing circle-placement operation considers in order.

instruments.title: Lattice Marks
instruments.description: Columns and Rows set the actual dimensions sent to occupiedLatticePaths2D.

instruments.title: Band Marks
instruments.description: Draw meandering paths, isolated nodes or short transverse ticks from independently placed starts.

instruments.title: Branch Marks
instruments.description: Grow sparse forks, small trees or loose groves with editable root placement and generation-by-generation branching.

instruments.title: Cut Branch Marks
instruments.description: Make split, twig-like line fragments from one freely positioned starting segment.

instruments.title: Loop Marks
instruments.description: The starting row contains three differently phased, lobed loops with colored diamonds spaced along their outlines.

instruments.title: Region Marks
instruments.description: A seeded quadrant partition repeatedly replaces one eligible leaf with four quadrants.

instruments.title: Panel Marks
instruments.description: Binary partition attempts cut an integer grid into ordered rectangular leaves.

instruments.title: Cut Marks
instruments.description: Build a seeded panel layout, then apply direct retained-rectangle cuts or removals.

instruments.title: Polygon Marks
instruments.description: Center X/Y, Source width/height, Source sides, and Source angle define a convex placement domain.

instruments.title: Facet Marks
instruments.description: Center X/Y, Source width/height, Source sides and Source angle create a triangular or convex polygonal site domain, not a fixed canvas-sized triangle.

instruments.title: Grain Marks
instruments.description: Place one or more editable source polygons with Center X/Y, Polygon width/height, Polygon sides, Source angle, Source groups, and Group spread.

instruments.title: Pull Marks
instruments.description: Arrange source paths and pull them toward one or two editable radial influences.

instruments.title: Projection Marks
instruments.description: Arrange source paths and project them away from one or two ordered discs.

instruments.title: Path Clip Marks
instruments.description: Clip rows, wandering paths or a fan through an editable simple boundary.

instruments.title: Ramp Marks
instruments.description: A local mark grid samples a positioned RGB palette ramp through stopRamp.

instruments.title: Warp Marks
instruments.description: Construct a small transparent RGBA image from bars, discs, rings or tiles, then sample it through a local deformation map.

instruments.title: Blur Marks
instruments.description: Filter an editable transparent RGBA population of bars, discs, rings or tiles with independently sized horizontal and vertical kernels.

instruments.title: Revolved Profiles
instruments.description: Build pinched columns, flared profiles and open wire shells by editing the form's silhouette.

instruments.title: Annular Marks
instruments.description: Show a graphic arc from a thick ring, or keep only wire edges and selected walls.

instruments.title: Depth Marks
instruments.description: Make faceted, tapered forms with colored patches that can change without deforming the mesh.

instruments.title: Spring Marks
instruments.description: Draw converging filaments, looping traces or spare spokes by moving starting bodies and targets independently.

instruments.title: Cell Fields
instruments.description: Make a colored mosaic confined to an editable local patch, or strip it back to cell outlines, facets and site marks.

instruments.title: Cell Echoes
instruments.description: Build nested polygonal rings inside a local cell field, from a few separated cells to dense contour textures.

instruments.title: Stitched Paths
instruments.description: Lay transverse marks along editable local waves.

instruments.title: Orbit Beads
instruments.description: Arrange beads around editable closed orbits.

instruments.title: Contour Fields
instruments.description: Draw flat contour patches from waves, noise, hills or your own height grid, without a filled background.

instruments.title: Contour Blobs
instruments.description: Make isolated hill rings, merging islands or rippling loop sequences from an editable field.

instruments.title: Rounded Panels
instruments.description: Repeat softened polygon panels as a loose quilt, a tight grid, or overlapping shapes.

instruments.title: Flowing Brushes
instruments.description: Chaikin corner cuts turn sampled, angular trajectories into continuous brush sweeps.

instruments.title: Contour Abstraction
instruments.description: One sampled trajectory is repeatedly simplified into coarse-to-fine records, then spaced perpendicular to its direction.

instruments.title: Gesture Skeletons
instruments.description: Separately seeded open gestures are sampled, simplified and left as sparse, articulated fragments.

instruments.title: Road Margins
instruments.description: Draw parallel edges beside one or more winding open routes.

instruments.title: Nested Contour Strokes
instruments.description: Build contour ink around an editable closed polygon.

instruments.title: Scatter Envelopes
instruments.description: Independent seeded point populations determine actual convex hulls.

instruments.title: Terraced Islands
instruments.description: Every island starts with its own seeded sites and a real convex hull.

instruments.title: Faceted Silhouettes
instruments.description: Turn a straight-sided silhouette into colored triangular paper planes, with optional facet edges and grain marks.

instruments.title: Concave Grain
instruments.description: Break a silhouette with inward corners, then colour its straight triangular facets and add fan lines or dots within each one.

instruments.title: Path Materials
instruments.description: Path Materials draws marks along a local family of seeded, bending trajectories.

instruments.title: Fragmented Lines
instruments.description: The Fragmented Lines starting recipe opens Path Materials with broken dashes and gaps; the Stitched Contours starting recipe opens the same instrument with stitches.

instruments.title: Spaced Marks
instruments.description: Spaced Marks is a Poisson-disc placement instrument for drawing at sites at least Minimum separation apart.

instruments.title: Spaced Symbols
instruments.description: The Symbols starting recipe opens the same Spaced Marks Poisson-disc placement instrument as Stipple, with square marks and a larger spacing initially.

instruments.title: Relaxed Stones
instruments.description: Build a small cluster of inset polygonal stones, an open cellular web or the gradual tracks of relaxing sites.

instruments.title: Centroid Trails
instruments.description: Draw short site-motion trails, then optionally expose their surrounding cell outlines.

instruments.title: Packed Shapes
instruments.description: Packed Shapes generates a seeded population of rectangles, then gives that ordered population to skyline packing.

instruments.title: Aspect Tiles
instruments.description: The Aspect Tiles starting recipe opens Packed Shapes with a broader initial width/height distribution than Posters; both use the same skyline packing instrument.

instruments.title: Obstacle Roads
instruments.description: Draw orthogonal routes through an editable cost and obstacle field, from a few separated segments to branching shared routes.

instruments.title: Arrival Contours
instruments.description: Trace cost rings that bend around expensive cells and stop at obstacles or unreachable regions.

instruments.title: Flow Traces
instruments.description: Paint filled strips beside genuine RK4 trajectories through a sampled vector grid.

instruments.title: Curved Trajectories
instruments.description: Follow starts arranged on a ring through a field assembled from uniform drift and independent signed radial and rotational velocity sources.

instruments.title: Reaction Spots
instruments.description: Grow a field of colored discs from a chosen starting pattern.

instruments.title: Reaction Stripes
instruments.description: Build a changing field of colored square cells from an editable starting pattern.

instruments.title: Organic Cells
instruments.description: Grow rounded colonies from a starting grid you can replace.

instruments.title: Geometric Generations
instruments.description: Turn a chosen starting grid into a field of colored square cells.

instruments.title: Rule Rows
instruments.description: Make angular row patterns, sparse triangular growth or irregular binary textures; choose the mark shape independently of the pattern.

instruments.title: Triangle Glyphs
instruments.description: Turn a rule-grown row pattern into clusters of triangles, dots or bars, with room for negative space.

instruments.title: Swirling Particles
instruments.description: Release paths from an editable source region into a seeded scalar curl field.

instruments.title: Flow Needles
instruments.description: Look at the directions of a seeded scalar curl field as individual vector marks rather than advected paths.

instruments.title: Ripple Interference
instruments.description: Place one to three signed disturbances in a square wave field, then watch their contours meet and interfere.

instruments.title: Pinned Waves
instruments.description: Shape wave contours around cells that must remain still.

instruments.title: Branching Sentences
instruments.description: Grow a single off-center sprig, a wide fan, or a dispersed grove from the same branching grammar.

instruments.title: Grammar Paths
instruments.description: Grammar Paths lets you write an axiom and parallel productions for F, G, X, Y.

instruments.title: Turtle Canopies
instruments.description: Grow branching fragments from editable turtle productions.

instruments.title: Recursive Tiles
instruments.description: The Recursive Tiles starting recipe opens Grammar Paths with an F/G tile path instead of Woven Fold's X/Y fold.

instruments.title: Edge Tiles
instruments.description: A sparse, edge-matched mosaic made by adjacencyTileCollapse2D.

instruments.title: Tiled Circuits
instruments.description: This preset favors straight and turning paths of actual edge-matched connectors.

instruments.title: Lattice Forests
instruments.description: Lattice Forests builds a local four-neighbor lattice, removes seeded blocked sites, and runs seededDepthFirstSpanningTree separately on each connected island.

instruments.title: Branching Networks
instruments.description: The Branching Network starting recipe opens Lattice Forests with a lighter site-and-edge treatment than Maze Garden.

instruments.title: Dithered Marks
instruments.description: Dithered Marks composes an independently seeded set of compact features into a local scalar image.

instruments.title: Dithered Ribbons
instruments.description: The Ribbons starting recipe opens Dithered Marks with elongated strokes from retained bits; Engraving begins with small dots.

instruments.title: Ordered Halftone
instruments.description: An editable seeded scalar source is sampled on a grid and screened with the actual bayerDither operation.

instruments.title: Bayer Weave
instruments.description: The same local seeded scalar source drives bayerDither, but retained bits print crossed horizontal and vertical bars instead of dots.

instruments.title: Embossed Field
instruments.description: Turn seeded source features into raised-looking fragments, scattered textures, or a broad relief.

instruments.title: Signed Edge Print
instruments.description: Extract two-ink edge marks from seeded, editable grayscale source geometry.

instruments.title: Distance Halos
instruments.description: A small, editable group of distinct raster sites becomes a measured distance field through euclideanDistanceTransform2D.

instruments.title: Nearest Feature Mosaic
instruments.description: The same editable binary feature-site source used by Distance Halos divides a sample grid by true nearest-site ownership.

instruments.title: Eroded Lace
instruments.description: The same editable seeded scalar source as Dilated Stamps becomes a binary mask at Mask cutoff.

instruments.title: Dilated Stamps
instruments.description: This is the same binary-mask instrument as Eroded Lace, set to grow instead of shrink.

instruments.title: Perceptual Bands
instruments.description: Sculpt an Oklab color field with an editable piecewise-linear edge profile and open rank-cell gaps.

instruments.title: Oklab Orbits
instruments.description: Open elliptical arc stacks with eccentric centers and an Oklab gradient across ranks or along each arc.

instruments.title: Reduced Mosaic
instruments.description: An independently seeded collection of compact source features supplies local scalar samples.

instruments.title: Quantized Stripes
instruments.description: Reduce an editable RGB source to a smaller palette, then place its weighted colors in rows of separated strips or tiles.

instruments.title: Extruded Seals
instruments.description: Make a solid seal from a beveled or stepped 2D footprint.

instruments.title: Stepped Blocks
instruments.description: Cut a shoulder into a polygon footprint and extrude it into a block.

instruments.title: Transported Ribbons
instruments.description: Sweep a variable-width strip along a 3D centerline.

instruments.title: Twisting Streamers
instruments.description: Bend a strip through repeated vertical and depth turns to make a folding streamer.

instruments.title: Rounded Polyhedra
instruments.description: Refine a coarse 3D source mesh into a softer polyhedral form.

instruments.title: Subdivided Shells
instruments.description: Build a faceted or softened shell from a small triangle mesh.

instruments.title: Ornament Field
instruments.description: Build a loose botanical scatter or an ordered decorative repeat.

instruments.title: Shape Matrix
instruments.description: Arrange wedges, crossed bars, discs and open arcs on an editable grid.

instruments.title: Orbital Brush
instruments.description: Shape a family of closed paths, then draw equal-distance samples as beads, connected ribbons or short perpendicular dashes.

instruments.title: Proximity Replay
instruments.description: Build current-neighbor webs or sparse chains from an editable moving population.

instruments.title: Agent Trails
instruments.description: Draw retained motion as filaments, lines of dots or final-velocity rakes, with links and body marks optional.

instruments.title: Lingering Links
instruments.description: Make a small cluster of crossing, fading connections or an expansive constellation.

instruments.title: Sensing Trails
instruments.description: Trace moving lines through a seeded landscape of compact scalar peaks.

instruments.title: Flocking Marks
instruments.description: Draw collective, localized trajectories from a seeded population.

instruments.title: Guarded Bands
instruments.description: Guarded bands is an ordered selection instrument: each seeded center path becomes a variable-width filled strip, and the selector accepts it only if its filled boundary, not merely its centerline, clears strips already retained.

instruments.title: Hatched Islands
instruments.description: Seed and source controls construct a star-shaped island with zero or more strictly interior, disjoint perforations.

instruments.title: Bridge Web
instruments.description: Construct a family of parallel strands, then let each candidate cross the current graph.

instruments.title: Neighborhood Growth
instruments.description: Seed an initial population in an area, a ring or a line, and independently seed a proposal pool in a separate square region.

instruments.title: Elastic Loops
instruments.description: Start from seeded ordered open filaments or concentric closed loops, then grow their actual rest lengths and bend targets.

instruments.title: Dye Currents
instruments.description: Build local pigment from one droplet or several independently seeded, rotated elliptical deposits.

instruments.title: Weighted Image Atlas
instruments.description: Construct a *local* density field and sample it into marks.

instruments.title: Word Echo
instruments.description: Marks walk either editable licensed glyph contours or an independent spiral/wave.

instruments.title: Interference Lace
instruments.description: Two crossing wave families make ribbed ribbons, bead-like islands and cellular lace.

instruments.title: Attractor Growth
instruments.description: Seed target points first, then place roots independently.

instruments.title: Flame Clouds
instruments.description: A population of contractive affine transformations drives fractalFlameAccumulate2D into a fixed 216 × 216 bilinear density grid.

instruments.title: Escape Contours
instruments.description: complexEscapeDistance2D samples the actual quadratic map $z\mapsto z^2+c$.

instruments.title: Woven Strands
instruments.description: Two families of ink paths share one lattice of junctions.

instruments.title: Registered Screens
instruments.description: Two independently editable ink line screens occupy a shared rectangular source footprint.

instruments.title: Asemic Lines
instruments.description: A seeded dictionary of abstract paths is built once from knot geometry and smoothed with the toolkit's Chaikin polyline operation.

instruments.title: Chord Looms
instruments.description: Two independent source curves are constructed as ellipses, radially lobed closed loops, or open arcs.

instruments.title: Harmonic Traces
instruments.description: Draw Lissajous rosettes, damped tangles or ordered stitches by combining editable oscillators.

instruments.title: Phyllotactic Whorls
instruments.description: Arrange leaf-like marks, discs or bars around a spiral whorl; adjust divergence to change its visible arms and optional rank links.

instruments.title: Contour Relief
instruments.description: Build a folded height-surface fragment with level curves on its faces, or leave only the suspended contour lines.
